data.revised_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production-ready mobile game art for a portrait Cocos Creator cat-themed 2048 game
Primary request: create a coherent original visual system that feels playful, artistic, collectible, and immediately readable on a phone screen
Style/medium: premium 2D cartoon game illustration, bold graphic shapes, expressive hand-painted color blocking, subtle paper-grain texture, polished editorial character design, slightly asymmetrical handmade charm
Art direction: rounded silhouettes, large simple shapes, confident contour lines, restrained highlights, soft upper-left lighting, gentle lower-right grounding shadow when appropriate
Color palette: warm ivory interface neutrals with coral, teal, mustard, leaf green, raspberry, sky blue, and violet accents; avoid a one-note palette
Mobile readability: every icon and character must remain recognizable at 64-80 px; simplify tiny details and preserve strong silhouettes
Consistency: use the same line weight, eye design, proportions, lighting direction, and painterly texture across every asset
Constraints: original artwork only; no text, numbers, letters, logos, trademarks, watermark, QR code, mockup frame, UI screenshot, photorealism, anime rendering, plastic 3D render, excessive gloss, thin sketch lines, clutter, or busy micro-details

Create a 4 by 4 sprite sheet on one perfectly flat solid chroma-key green #00FF00 background containing exactly sixteen isolated decorative game assets, with very wide green gutters, row-major order. Do not use #00FF00 inside any asset. First six are distinct circular cat avatar frames: coral yarn, teal fish, mustard bell, leafy green using a darker natural green rather than chroma green, raspberry bows, and a premium silver aurora star frame. Next two are seamless-looking square tile pattern swatches: scattered cat paws and simple fish bones. Last eight are expressive sharing stickers with no text: happy cat face, surprised cat face, proud cat face, sleepy cat face, sparkling paws, celebratory fish, tiny crown with cat ears, and aurora shooting star. No gradient, texture, floor, panels, or shadows in the chroma background. Use bold graphic shapes, artistic hand-painted texture, strong outlines, no letters or numbers. Leave the last two grid cells as small abstract confetti clusters so all sixteen cells contain one isolated asset.
